verdict.rationale: Notte lets you deploy browser automations as serverless Functions that you can invoke as API endpoints and schedule. That gives time-based triggers and lets external systems call an automation, but it is not a rule engine for event-driven actions. Missing for 10: a documented rule or condition definition system, native event triggers (webhooks or page/data-change events), docs on how trigger configuration works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
